top_signals.title: Chip Stocks Get Hit as Global Bond Anxiety Builds
top_signals.summary:
A selloff in chipmakers sent stocks lower, with the market also falling as inflation angst and rising government debt kept bond yields elevated.
John Mowrey, CIO at NFJ Investment Group, discusses AI capex spending and equities reaching all-time highs. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump says no talks scheduled with Iran as he teases action in Hormuz Strait
top_signals.summary: Trump insists the U.S., not Iran, is in control of the strait, even though transiting vessels continue to come under attack and few attempt the crossing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
top_signals.summary: Security experts have been sounding the alarm for years about the risks of using generic TV boxes that promise unlimited content streaming for a one-time fee, warning that they secretly rent the user's Internet connection out to strangers. But a groundbreaking new analysis finds these devices also routinely spoof themselves as mobile phones clicking ads on AI-generated websites as part of sprawling operation that seeks to defraud online merchants and advertising networks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Raw Sugar Advances to 14-Month High on Global Supply Concerns
top_signals.summary: Raw sugar futures rose to the highest in more than a year as India, the world’s second-largest producer, is considering cutting import duties on the commodity in the latest sign of global supply constraint.
